name: Theth & Albanian Alps in a day
description_md:
Theth and Albanian Alps in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city main sights located in AL. The route covers 12.8 km of walking between stops and takes about 6.8 hours for the full day.

This anchored day includes visit time at each stop. Walkers travel to four sightseeing stops along the way.
